resources.string: Booking Information: The line, origin and destination stations, number of passengers for each fare type, fare amount, booking date, payment status, and reference number of each booking.

Payment Information: The PayPal order ID, amount paid, payment status, and payment date. You log in and pay on PayPal\'s own page, so RailTap never sees or stores your PayPal password or card details.
QR Pass Information: The QR code of each passenger\'s pass, its expiry time, and the times and stations where it was scanned at the entry and exit gates.
Account Information: Your full name, email address, and optional profile photo. Your password is handled by Supabase Authentication and is not stored by RailTap in readable form.
Contact Information: Anything you include in emails you send to RailTap support.
